messages:
Maya (Finance): FYI invoice #99211 (Veridian Health) ACH failed for $48,750. Bank returned 'account holder mismatch'. Need ops: re-collect ACH or accept wire? They prefer wire.
Jon (Billing Ops): Share bank error id?
Maya (Finance): bank_err_0x9a2f - msg: "account_holder_mismatch: beneficiary_name differs from ACH name"
billing-bot: Payment failure logged for veridian-health, method=ach, last4=****6789, event=payment_failed
Jon (Billing Ops): Looking at initial form: customer entered "VeridianHealth LLC" vs bank registered name "Veridian Health, LLC" (comma/spacing). Microdeposits never verified. Recommend no auto-retry until name confirmed.
Rina (CS): On call with procurement now. They say treasury can wire tonight but procurement needs invoice + bank routing to attach to PO. I'll request PO and remittance screenshot.
Maya (Finance): For wires >$25k we need Sam approval and AML screen. Tagging Sam: @Sam can you pre-approve conditional wire once PO + remittance PDF + signed SOW are provided?
Sam (Finance Lead): Conditional okay. Require PO, SOW, remittance that shows beneficiary name and amount. Run AML/sanctions check and verify remittance matches SOW beneficiary. No funds release until docs reviewed.
Jon (Billing Ops): I'll place invoice 99211 on temporary hold (reason=ACH_name_mismatch). Create internal ticket: https://app.redwood/billing/tickets/4029. Will set attempts=1 and next_action=await_docs.
Rina (CS): I'll DM the PO and remittance to Jon and Maya when I have them. Customer agrees to re-submit ACH only if legal name corrected; they prefer wire to speed up.
Maya (Finance): Ok. If remittance arrives, we'll run AML check and then create manual payout: payout_6217 pending_review. Note: don't attempt ACH retry more than once in 24h to avoid bank soft-blocks.
billing-bot: Manual payout created payout_6217 status=pending_review assigned_to=Jon
Jon (Billing Ops): Audit note: failure_code=account_holder_mismatch; initial_attempts=1; customer_contacted=true; preferred_method=wire.
Maya (Finance): Thanks team. Keep updates here. If docs arrive, ping me and Sam for final sign-off. :+1:
